title: Distribution Function
description: Essential Criteria: The expression for the distribution function f(ε, T=0) must be correctly identified as a step function.

title: Total Energy Expression
description: Essential Criteria: The total ground state kinetic energy U must be expressed as U = (3/5) N ε_F.

title: Pressure Relation
description: Essential Criteria: The relationship between pressure and volume must be derived as p = (2/5) (N/V) ε_F.

title: Compressibility Derivation
description: Essential Criteria: The expression for compressibility K must be correctly derived in terms of N, V, and ε_F.

title: Integration Check
description: Important Criteria: The integral of the density of states must correctly count the number of particles, confirming the relationship between A and B.

title: Sign Errors
description: Pitfall Criteria: Common errors include sign mistakes in the pressure calculation or misinterpretation of the derivatives.

title: Units Consistency
description: Optional Criteria: Ensure that all derived expressions maintain consistent units throughout the calculations.
